facts.fact: The Minister of Finance and Budget's communication to the Council of Ministers states that the SIGOMAP dematerialised procurement application, piloted with seven structures and then extended, is now the sole platform for managing public procurement, and that dematerialisation cut bid-document processing from 9.9 to 6.5 days in 2023.

The communication states that SIGOMAP, already used for contract numbering and approval steps, is the only procurement platform and that the Ministry of Finance and Budget extends its operation to all contracting authorities of the ministries from 2024.
